name: Employee Excellence Awards
description: Air Canada's 2017 white and black on a widebody, with the year's Excellence Award recipients honoured on it: their names in small white type in rows down the black fin under the red roundel, and a large black title on the rear fuselage with a smaller line under it. 2024 (787-9 C-FVNB, fin 857): 'CONGRATULATIONS' on the left side and 'FÉLICITATIONS' on the right over the aft windows, '2024 Employee Excellence Awards recipients' under it, 65 names on the fin. 2025 (787-9 C-FSBV, fin 852): 'EXCELLENCE | 2025' in thin spaced capitals over the windows behind the wing, 'Congratulations to our award-winning employees' under it, 55 names on the fin. Each year's jet keeps its scheme after the next is painted (C-FVNB was still in the 2024 version in May 2025).

sources.title: Air Canada newsroom: Honouring Air Canada's Excellence Award Recipients (2025), with its hangar photo of fin 852 (airline press photo)
sources.note: The 2025 recipients' 55 names on the tail of fin 852, a 787 (C-FSBV, its registration on the photo), for the second year running. The photo (from above and behind, in the hangar, 2025-04-08) shows the fin's rows of names under the roundel and the 'EXCELLENCE | 2025' title; looked at only, not measured (not a side view), not copied or shipped.

sources.note: C-FVNB's left side climbing out of Hong Kong, 2025-05-28, from below against cloud: 'CONGRATULATIONS' and '2024 Employee Excellence Awards recipients' on the aft fuselage, a year after the paint; too dark and steep to measure.

sources.title: JetPhotos: C-FIVM, 777-300ER, Rome 2026-05-31
sources.note: Evidence only: a '2026 Employee Excellence' scheme on 777-300ER C-FIVM, 50 names on the tail. No open or airline photo found (Commons' C-FIVM category, 69 files, has nothing newer than 2021, checked 2026-11-23).

notes: Described in words only, for the 2024 (C-FVNB) and 2026 (C-FIVM) versions. The 2025 version (C-FSBV) is drawn separately as ACA/excellence-awards-2025, measured from Commons photos of both sides (2025), and C-FSBV is tagged there. 2024: the open photos of C-FVNB are from well below while climbing out of Hong Kong (2025-05-28; its 'Light version' makes the left titles readable but it's still too steep to measure) and a partial view of its tail and aft right side at Heathrow (2024-09-12). 2026: no open or airline photo of C-FIVM in it (Commons checked 2026-11-23). The rest is Air Canada's 2017 standard (ACA/standard draws it). Each year's titles and names differ, so each year that gets drawn becomes its own scheme.
history: New 2026-11-22. Air Canada first put its Excellence Award recipients on a jet in 2024 (C-FVNB), then 2025 (C-FSBV), reportedly 2026 (C-FIVM). 2026-11-23: the 2025 version split out as ACA/excellence-awards-2025 (drawn); this scheme keeps 2024 and 2026.
